name: tasklean
description: Task-scoped SSH and dataset reuse, reviewable prompt optimization, and measured Codex usage.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse task state and measure task efficiency.
interface.longDescription: Local/SSH prototype with reusable connections, bounded in-memory datasets, passive prompt-size telemetry, optional prompt rewriting and measured usage. Savings are not guaranteed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit this project for unnecessary context and explain what TaskLean can measure.
